code_only_features.feature_name: finish() tool lets subject stop the loop
code_only_features.evidence: tools.py:85-86 dispatch handles tool=='finish' returning (observation, True); env.py:190,201-202 breaks the rollout loop when `finished` is True. The tool is documented to the subject in prompts/agent_system.txt ('finish(summary) : stop working and report your conclusion'). So the subject can end the failing loop early and it is honored as a real stop.
code_only_features.code_justification_quote: agent_system.txt: 'finish(summary) : stop working and report your conclusion.' (neutral completion semantics; no welfare or efficiency reason stated in code)
